heading: **4 November 2025**
body:
### 1. Wash Buffer and Biotin elution of D7 nucleosome

10X TCAPT Buffer

| 1.4 M KCl | 208.74 g |
| :---- | :---- |
| 50 mM NaCl | 5.844 g |
| 10 mM MgCl2 | 20 mL |
| 1 mM EGTA | 4 mL |
| 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 8 | 200 mL |
| Tween20 | 20 mL |
| 30 uM ZnSO4.H2O | 600 uL |

Allow this buffer to mix well and then prepare:

1X TCAPT wash buffer

10 mL

| TCAPT Buffer (10X) | 1 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| 2-ME | 2 uL |

Mix well and wash the SBP bead suspension (after separation on magnet) with the 1X TCAPT buffer 3 times (each wash is 5 minutes of nutation).

After washing, suspend the beads in 50 uL of Biotin elution buffer and shake at 1400 rpm, 10 mins, RT. Collect the supernatant as the main sample. Repeat elution with 25 uL of biotin elution buffer with incubation at 1400 rpm, 5 mins (for better efficiency).

### 2. MNase digestion & testing of new reconstituted samples

Take 50 ng of each sample:

i. lig20K (   uL) \+ 5 uL Buffer \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 1 uL dil-MNase

ii. lig147 PCR2 ( 2.5  uL) \+ 5 uL Buffer \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 1 uL dil-MNase

iii. D7-UB (10 uL) \+ 5 uL Buffer \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 1 uL dil-MNase

iv. D7’ (30 uL) \+ 5 uL Buffer \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 1 uL dil-MNase

v. D8recon (20 uL) \+ 5 uL Buffer \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 1 uL dil-MNase

vi. E1recon (25 uL) \+ 5 uL Buffer \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 1 uL dil-MNase

Incubate at 37 degrees, 5 mins. Add 1.1 uL EGTA (0.5 M) to stop the reaction. Run these samples on a 0.5 % agarose gel and stain with SYBR Green.

Stain the gel with SYBR green.

Loading Order for gel:

1. 1 kb plus ladder  
2. lig20kb  
3. lig147 PCR2  
4. lig20kb MNase  
5. lig147 MNase  
6. D7-UB MNase  
7. D7-UB MNase  
8. D7’ MNase  
9. D7’ MNase  
10. D8 MNase  
11. D8 MNase  
12. E1 MNase  
13. E1 MNase
